asks: Keep the Lesser Slave Lake district (enlarged with the rest of Big Lakes County, the MD of Lesser Slave River, Swan Hills and Fort Assiniboine), keep nine northern districts with adjusted boundaries, and create more urban-rural hybrid districts.

quote: A key aspect is maintaining the existence of the Lesser Slave Lake electoral district, which helps prevent Northern Alberta from losing too many electoral districts
note: Joint proposal of several northern MLAs, filed by Tany Yao. p.40: start from current Lesser Slave Lake and add the rest of Big Lakes County, the County of Lesser Slave River, and part of Woodlands County with Fort Assiniboine; Swan Hills inside. Rejection of the interim removal at p.40: 'The interim report's proposed boundaries were rejected because removing the Lesser Slave Lake electoral district resulted in a variety of problems'.
St. Albert named only in a list of capital-region places said to share a community of interest, in support of hybrids in general; no request about St. Albert.

asks: Put any additional Calgary seat in the south of the city, not in central Calgary.
The City of Airdrie supports the interim Airdrie-West and Airdrie-East divisions, with Crossfield in Airdrie-East, and speaks well of Cochrane-Springbank.

quote: The City of Airdrie strongly supports the Commission's proposed creation of Airdrie-West and Airdrie-East electoral divisions, including the incorporation of the Town of Crossfield within Airdrie-East.
note: City of Airdrie, round 2. Text appears twice (webform pp.51-54, attachment pp.55-58).

quote: The proposed Cochrane-Springbank electoral division similarly reflects thoughtful consideration of community connections and growth patterns in the region northwest of Calgary. We support the Commission's approach
note: Approval of the interim Cochrane-Springbank division, given in passing by the City of Airdrie; the support sentence is general ('the Commission's approach to creating electoral divisions that bring together communities of interest').

quote: The inclusion of Crossfield in Airdrie-East has facilitated beneficial boundary adjustments in neighboring electoral divisions, including Mountain View-Kneehill.
note: Supports Crossfield in Airdrie-East ('Crossfield belongs with Airdrie' maps to O2) and calls the effect on Mountain View-Kneehill beneficial; says nothing of Sundre, Irricana or Beiseker.

asks: Keep Mayland Heights in Calgary-Klein, narrow the population spread between districts, and do not create hybrid districts around Calgary and Edmonton.
Keep Lethbridge-East and Lethbridge-West as urban districts as in the interim report, and reject the MLA's plan to divide Lethbridge in four with rural areas.

quote: It is important for Lethbridge East and West to remain urban focused areas. I most emphatically disagree with the proposal put forward by Lethbridge East MLA Nathan Neudorf.
note: Agrees with the interim map; rejects the four-quarter plan in terms: 'In dividing Lethbridge into four quarters and pulling in rural residents, he is changing the dynamics of two urban ridings'.

asks: Do not put Okotoks in a district with Calgary (interim Calgary-Okotoks); the writer fears losing a rural voice.
Keep Edmonton districts within municipal boundaries and avoid forming hybrid ridings.

Give Lethbridge a third MLA by having Cardston-Taber-Warner take in north Lethbridge as an urban-rural hybrid, move Forty Mile County to Medicine Hat-Cypress, and rename that district Medicine Hat-Strom.

quote: This allows CTW to absorb the northern portion of the City of Lethbridge. This creates a third Lethbridge-focused MLA through an urban-rural hybrid model
note: Three seats: Lethbridge-West, Lethbridge-East and one north Lethbridge hybrid with Cardston-Taber-Warner (p.69: 'dividing Lethbridge interests across three constituencies—West, East, and a North-Hybrid'). Particulars differ from the four-way plan, so L3 (rule 7). Praises urban-rural hybrids as a design for the region.

asks: Create a regional southern Alberta district joining portions of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton, Cardston, Magrath, Raymond and Stirling.

quote: A district that includes portions of Lethbridge together with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton Lakes National Park, and the communities of Cardston, Magrath, Raymond, and Stirling would accurately reflect how southern Albertans live.
note: Asks for one district joining part of Lethbridge to towns and country to the south-west; does not describe the four-way plan or say how the rest of the city is treated. campaign: same request and near-identical wording as EBC-2025-2-0678, 0680, 0682, 0683 (first in this batch; earlier copies may exist).

asks: Create a regional southern Alberta district linking parts of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton, Cardston, Magrath, Raymond and Stirling.

quote: A district that links parts of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton Lakes National Park, and Cardston, Magrath, Raymond, and Stirling would accurately reflect how southern Albertans live and interact.
note: One district joining part of Lethbridge to towns and country; not the four-way plan in terms. campaign EBC-2025-2-0677.

asks: Halt the removal of rural constituencies and leave Central Peace-Notley unchanged, or failing that add Grimshaw, Teepee Creek or Nampa to it.
Create a southern Alberta regional district combining parts of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton, Cardston, Magrath, Raymond and Stirling.

quote: A district that combines parts of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton Lakes National Park, and Cardston, Magrath, Raymond, and Stirling would do exactly that.
note: One district joining part of Lethbridge to towns and country; not the four-way plan in terms. campaign EBC-2025-2-0677.

asks: Keep all of Clearwater County within a single constituency rather than dividing it among three interim districts.

quote: I respectfully ask the Commission to reconsider the proposed boundaries and ensure that all of Clearwater County remains within a single constituency
note: Rejection: 'dividing Clearwater County into multiple constituencies will make it more difficult for residents' (p.84). Says nothing of what else should be in the district. Banff-Jasper named only in header; not an RMH-B mention.

asks: Create a regional southern Alberta district uniting portions of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton, Cardston, Magrath, Raymond and Stirling.

quote: A district that unites portions of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton Lakes National Park, and the communities of Cardston, Magrath, Raymond, and Stirling would do precisely that.
note: One district joining part of Lethbridge to towns and country; not the four-way plan in terms. campaign EBC-2025-2-0677.

asks: Create a regional southern Alberta district bringing together parts of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton, Cardston, Magrath, Raymond and Stirling.

quote: A district that brings together parts of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton Lakes National Park, and the communities of Cardston, Magrath, Raymond, and Stirling would accurately reflect how people in this region interact
note: One district joining part of Lethbridge to towns and country; not the four-way plan in terms. campaign EBC-2025-2-0677.

asks: Do not eliminate Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre; keep Clearwater County whole in one constituency with other west central Alberta communities.

quote: I strongly urge the Commission to reconsider the proposed boundaries and to keep Clearwater County together within a single constituency alongside other west central Alberta communities.
note: Former Reeve of Clearwater County. Rejection (p.92): 'serious concerns regarding the proposed elimination of the Rimbey–Rocky Mountain House–Sundre constituency and the division of Clearwater County into three separate electoral ridings'. Contrasts the region with 'prairie and urban communities to the east'. Banff-Jasper only in header; no RMH-B.

asks: Do not eliminate Lesser Slave Lake; keep it with a 15(2) exemption and extend it to all of Big Lakes County, including Swan Hills.

quote: This is my submission in opposition to the elimination of the Lesser Slave Lake riding.
note: p.96: 'respectfully submit that the riding of Lesser Slave Lake be moved at the very least to include all of Big Lakes County boundaries to the south which would encompass the Town of Swan Hills'; also suggests all of Lesser Slave River.

asks: Without asking for Lesser Slave Lake to be restored, keep the Big Lakes County lakeshore communities in the same constituency as High Prairie.

quote: So rather than ask for a return to Lesser Slave Lake being intact, I want to comment on new challenges
note: Former MLA for Lesser Slave Lake; 'very disappointed to see the dismemberment of Lesser Slave Lake' but expressly does not ask for K1. Asks a modification of the interim plan: 'I strongly suggest that the lakeshore communities that are part of Big Lakes County continue to stay in the same constituency as High Prairie.' Coded K9 (interim with modification).

asks: Supports interim Calgary-Confluence, asks for an additional riding within Calgary, and cautions against hybrids joining Calgary with Airdrie, Chestermere or Springbank.

quote: I would humbly caution the Commission against creating hybrid ridings that combine parts of Calgary with communities such as Airdrie, Chestermere, or Springbank.
note: Rejection only; 'deserve their own ridings' is not specific enough for a want.

quote: I would humbly caution the Commission against creating hybrid ridings that combine parts of Calgary with communities such as Airdrie, Chestermere, or Springbank.
note: Rejection only. Same sentence as AIRDRIE row.

asks: Supports the interim boundaries for south Edmonton.
Do not divide Lethbridge into four districts.

quote: Submission Lethbridge should not be divided into 4.
note: Whole message is this sentence (7 words, quote takes the form label before it to reach 8). Reacts to the four-way proposal in circulation (MLA's plan), not to the interim map. Rejection only.

asks: Keep Edmonton-Highlands-Norwood cohesive as proposed, with Westwood added, and add more ridings to Edmonton.
Keep Manchester in Calgary-Acadia rather than moving it to Calgary-Confluence; praises the interim map for avoiding urban-rural hybrids.
Leave the Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundaries as they are.
Keep Rocky Mountain House united with Clearwater County and other Eastern Slopes communities in one district rather than dividing Clearwater County three ways.

quote: keeping Clearwater County, Rocky Mountain House, and other Eastern Slopes communities together in a single electoral division
note: Worked example 1 in the codebook. Former mayor of Rocky Mountain House. Also objects (p.116) to 'The decision to divide Clearwater County into three different constituencies'.

quote: Rocky has been at the center of a constituency that includes Clearwater County and western Mountain View County, extending all the way to the BC border.
note: Worked example 1 in the codebook. Offered as historical precedent for keeping the region whole, not as a request to add park land. Also notes the interim line puts the Rocky Mountain House National Historic Site in Banff-Jasper.

asks: Make Medicine Hat a fully urban district, or at minimum divide it along the South Saskatchewan River.

note: Red Deer named only as a comparison city (rule 6).
Lethbridge named only as a comparison city (rule 6).

asks: Leave the boundaries alone; rural and urban concerns are completely different.

quote: Don't touch the electoral boundaries. What's wrong with your people? Rural and urban concerns are completely different. Leave them alone.
note: Place given only by the header (Lethbridge resident, current and proposed Lethbridge-East). Asks that boundaries stay as they are and that rural and urban be kept apart, which for Lethbridge is the two city districts (rule 1, rule 2). Does not name Lethbridge in the message.

asks: Apply hybrid urban-rural ridings to Lethbridge and area instead of the interim two city districts.

quote: I submit that hybrid rural-urban boundaries for Lethbridge and area would better address the goal of effective representation.
note: Asks for hybrids for Lethbridge as a design without the four-way particulars (rule 7). p.125: 'I urge you to apply in southern Alberta the hybrid riding approach'. Calls two MLAs for Lethbridge inequitable.

asks: Add one or two more Edmonton districts for growth in the south and south-west; opposes rural-urban hybrid ridings.
Supports moving Whitehorn into Calgary-Cross and hopes for more seats in Calgary rather than combining Calgary with cities outside it.
Thanks the commission for keeping Edmonton's ridings within city limits and avoiding hybrids; keep Edmonton South as one urban constituency.
Retain the existing Edmonton South boundaries and do not make it a hybrid constituency.
Keep Lethbridge in two urban ridings within the municipal boundary, as in the interim report, and reject splitting it into four ridings with rural areas.

quote: I’m happy and thankful the commission has preliminarily chosen to maintain the integrity and history associated with Lethbridge in two
note: Quote continues on p.3: 'ridings by maintaining the current municipal boundary.' Rejection (p.2): 'A splitting of Lethbridge into four ridings and including the surrounding rural areas seems to be not only ineffective'. Reacts also to the MLA/Coaldale four-way proposal.

asks: Do not split Lethbridge into four ridings that take in surrounding rural areas.

quote: I am not in favour of the changes to make lethbridge split into four areas expanding into rural surrounding areas.
note: Rejection only; reacts to the four-way proposal in circulation, not to the interim map.

asks: Supports keeping Edmonton-Manning within city limits, adding a seat in Edmonton, and renaming the riding.
Keep Montgomery in Calgary-Bow with Bowness rather than moving it to Calgary-Varsity.

Keep Sundre, western Mountain View County and Clearwater County together along the Highway 22 corridor, keeping the east-west split of Mountain View County, rather than creating Mountain View-Kneehill.

quote: keep Eastern Slopes communities like Sundre, Western Mountain View County, and Clearwater County together in the same constituency.
note: Former Mountain View County councillor. Also: 'ensure that western communities are included with others along the Highway 22 corridor like Clearwater County and Rocky Mountain House' (p.12).

quote: A better option would be to maintain the same boundary dividing eastern and western Mountain View County
note: Sundre and western Mountain View County to the foothills riding (codebook OLDS-A partial-request rule). Rejection (p.12): 'I am concerned that by creating the Mountain View-Kneehill riding, the unique needs of western communities will lose their representation'. Says nothing about Crossfield, Irricana or Beiseker.

asks: Rename Edmonton-Manning and add another seat in Edmonton.
Keep Montgomery in Calgary-Bow with Bowness rather than moving it to Calgary-Varsity.
Opposes the larger interim northern ridings such as Peace River-Notley, wants area weighted equally with population, and no personal names in riding names.
Do not divide Chaparral between Calgary-Shaw and Calgary-Fish Creek; consider adding Heritage Pointe to Calgary-Shaw and more seats in south Calgary.
Supports the interim boundaries for Edmonton-North West, including the addition of Calder.
Do not split Chaparral across two ridings; add a new district in far south Calgary rather than downtown.
Create a Sherwood Park-Josephburg rural-urban riding with described boundaries in Strathcona County.
Add more electoral divisions overall, especially for Edmonton; would have preferred Edmonton-Rutherford's boundary moved north.
Restore Medicine Hat to a single unified urban riding.

note: Notes the four-way hybrid idea for Lethbridge 'was publicly discussed in the media' and that it raises 'broader concerns about [...] the potential normalization of dividing cohesive urban communities'. Concern about a trend, not a request about Lethbridge; coded mention only (rule 17).

asks: Keep Montgomery in the same riding as Bowness, and do not add communities outside Calgary to Calgary ridings.
Keep Edmonton-Riverview rather than reducing six central Edmonton seats to five; regrets the elimination of the Slave Lake constituency; praises keeping Lethbridge within its urban boundaries.

quote: I am pleased to read that you are respecting the urban boundaries of Lethbridge
note: Approves the interim two city districts (rule 5).

quote: The elimination of the Slave Lake constituency and the creation of the very large Mackenzie district is difficult to accept.
note: Objects to the interim dissolution; no explicit request to restore, but rule 4 translates the objection into K1. Edmonton writer who grew up in the north.

asks: Keep Okotoks in a rural riding, not grouped with the city of Calgary.
No specific request: says urban and rural Alberta both deserve fair representation.

note: Lethbridge-East resident (header). One-line message, 'Urban and Rural Alberta both deserve fair representation.', takes no stance on how Lethbridge is drawn.

asks: Add more seats to Calgary; thanks the commission for avoiding hybrid ridings; supports adding Arbour Lake to Calgary-Edgemont.
